info.purpose: Non-text info marks, header edge, avatar ring.

shadows.name: raised

motion.name: ease-out

typeRoles.note: Each heading role is one font shorthand token; h1/h2/h3 default to display/headline/title in index.css; .type-* classes for Tailwind markup. Compared figures use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

pageFrame.purpose: Every page root: padding var(--page-padding), max-width var(--content-max), centred; .page-frame is the same for Tailwind markup. Pages do not paint their own background or set min-height 100vh; .main-content carries --page-background.

narrative.overview:
Gifty is a working tool, not a showroom. People open it to check who has a birthday coming up, what they already bought, and how much budget is left. The interface should feel like a well-kept ledger: calm, legible, one confident teal used for the things you can act on, and everything else quiet. Brand lives in the details (the teal, the rounded Quicksand titles, the soft teal wash behind every page), not in decoration.

This file records the world the authenticated app already has, then consolidates it. The theming audit (2026-10-15) counted 212 distinct hex colors, 49 font sizes, 108 box-shadows and 19 radii across 46 CSS files. Most of that is drift: the same job done with four teals, five reds and three gray ramps borrowed from Bootstrap, Flat UI and Tailwind. Every canonical value below was picked from the values the app already uses most (usage counts in parentheses), and changed only where the incumbent fails WCAG AA. Nothing here is a redesign.

The app is in **Operate** mode everywhere except the public landing page. Scanability, consistency between pages and predictable controls outrank expression. The landing page (`/`) and the login and register pages currently use their own palette (coral #f74949, a red-purple-navy gradient, pink #e6739f, a Playfair serif that never loads). They are off-world and **move into the teal world** described here: same tokens, same buttons, same type.
keyCharacteristics: One brand teal (#006666, 274 uses) carries every primary action, page title and selected state.
A slate header (#334155) is the only dark surface; pages sit on a pale teal-to-gray wash with white cards.
Rounded but not bubbly: 8px controls, 12px cards and dialogs, pills only for chips and avatars.
Quicksand (the one webfont actually loaded) for titles and the wordmark; the system sans for everything you read.
Soft, low shadows; depth comes mostly from white cards on a tinted page.
Every color token has a dark-theme counterpart, so the Theme setting can become real.

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: Every interactive or selected thing is `primary`. A new screen does not introduce a second brand hue, a cyan, a steelblue button or a teal gradient.

rules.name: The Muted Floor Rule
rules.body: No text, including placeholders, is lighter than `ink-muted` (#666666) on light surfaces or `ink-muted` dark (#94a3b8) on dark ones.

rules.name: The Status Is Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, danger and info appear only when they mean that status. The header's rainbow icon hovers (orange, dodger blue, tomato, lime, gold) are decoration and go.

rules.name: The One Title Rule
rules.body: Every page opens with exactly one Display title: Quicksand 700, 2rem, `primary`, left-aligned at the start of the content column. No gradient text, no centering, no icon-in-title variants.

rules.name: The No Gradient Text Rule
rules.body: All eight `background-clip: text` headings (including the muddy header wordmark) become solid color. Emphasis comes from size and weight.

rules.name: The Three Shadows Rule
rules.body: A new surface uses Rest, Raised or Overlay. The other 105 shadow values in the code converge on these.

rules.name: The Calm Motion Rule
rules.body: Transitions animate `background-color`, `color`, `border-color`, `box-shadow` or `transform` over 150–200ms ease-out; never `transition: all` (over 100 uses today), and nothing moves under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Clickable cards may lift 2px on hover; nothing scales.

dos: **Do** use `primary` (#006666) for every primary action, link, selected state and page title, and `primary-strong` (#004c4c) for its hover.
**Do** put pages on the `primary-wash` → `surface-muted` gradient with white cards (lg 12px, Rest shadow, 24px padding).
**Do** use exactly one Display page title per page, left-aligned, Quicksand 700 2rem teal.
**Do** keep all text at `ink-muted` (#666666) or darker on light surfaces, and check ratios for every new pairing, including the dark theme.
**Do** use rem for type and the 4px spacing scale (4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 32 / 40) for every gap and padding.
**Do** confirm destructive actions in the shared dialog with a Danger button; report results with a toast.
**Do** give every focusable control the 2px `primary` focus ring.
**Do** bring the landing, login and register pages into this palette: teal primary buttons, Quicksand titles, the page wash background.
donts: **Don't** use coral (#f74949), the red-purple-navy landing gradient, the login pink #e6739f (2.86:1 with white text) or a serif anywhere; those pages move into the teal world.
**Don't** use steelblue (#4682b4), cyan (#0891b2), green (#2c922f) or a gradient as a button fill.
**Don't** use gradient text, including on the wordmark.
**Don't** use #888, #999 or #a0a0a0 for text or placeholders.
**Don't** add a new hex value, shadow or radius when a token covers the job; add a token here first.
**Don't** load a webfont from a third-party origin, or declare a font family that is not loaded.
**Don't** use decorative side stripes on cards, list items or notifications.
